features.name: Database Schema & Migration
features.description: Create sh_solution_departments, sh_department_status_history, sh_solution_types, sh_department_targets tables. Seed 44 departments and 3 default solution types. Add solution_type_id to sh_solutions.
test_steps: Run migration on staging Supabase
Verify all 4 tables created with correct columns
Verify 44 departments seeded in sh_solution_departments
Verify 3 default solution types seeded (Software, Training, Content)
Verify sh_solutions has new solution_type_id column
Verify existing solutions still work (backward compat)
Query sh_solution_departments to confirm all 44 entries with status 'active'

features.name: Solution Department Service & Hooks
features.description: Create service layer for solution departments: CRUD operations, status calculation (revenue-based), auto-dormancy logic, status history recording, revenue aggregation per department. Create React Query hooks.
test_steps: Service can list all solution departments with computed status
Service correctly calculates revenue per department from sh_payments
Service correctly identifies at_risk departments (1-2 months no revenue)
Service correctly identifies dormant departments (3+ months no revenue)
Status history is recorded on every status change
React hooks fetch and cache department data correctly
Revenue aggregation returns correct totals by period (month/quarter/year)

features.name: Dashboard Summary Section
features.description: Add department tracker summary to /solutions dashboard page: status count cards (Active/At Risk/Dormant), revenue leaderboard (top 5 + growth rate), health grid (44 depts color-coded by institution), quarterly trend chart.
test_steps: Navigate to /solutions - see department summary section
Status counts show correct numbers (green/amber/red)
Click status card to filter department list
Revenue leaderboard shows top 5 departments
Growth rate displayed alongside absolute revenue
Health grid shows all 44 departments grouped by institution
Health grid color-coding matches status (green/amber/red)
Click department in grid navigates to detail page
Trend chart shows quarterly revenue data
Time period selector works (Month/Quarter/Year)
Default view is current quarter

features.name: Department List & Detail Pages
features.description: Create /solutions/departments list page (sortable table with all 44 depts) and /solutions/departments/[id] detail page (full 360 view: revenue, pipeline, team, clients, history, comparison).
test_steps: Navigate to /solutions/departments - see all 44 departments in table
Table columns: Department, Institution, Status, Revenue, Target, Achievement%, Growth, Active Solutions
Sort by any column works
Filter by status works
Filter by institution works
Click department row navigates to detail page
Detail page shows department header with status badge
Revenue section shows month/quarter/year/all-time
Pipeline section shows active solutions with statuses
Status history timeline shows all transitions
Comparison section shows rank among all departments
Back button returns to list page

features.name: Solution Types CRUD
features.description: Create admin page to manage solution types (replacing fixed enum). Full CRUD: create, edit, toggle active, delete. Icon and color picker. Seed defaults (Software, Training, Content).
test_steps: Navigate to solution types management page
See 3 default types (Software, Training, Content)
Create new custom type with name, description, icon, color
Edit existing type
Toggle type active/inactive
New type appears in solution creation form
Existing solutions with old types still display correctly
Cannot delete a type that has active solutions

features.name: Quarterly Targets & HOD Self-Set
features.description: Enable HODs to set quarterly revenue targets for their department. Show target vs actual on dashboard and detail page with progress bar. Achievement percentage calculated automatically.
test_steps: HOD can navigate to their department settings
HOD can set target for current quarter
HOD can set target for next quarter
Target appears on department detail page with progress bar
Achievement % calculated correctly (actual/target * 100)
Dashboard leaderboard shows target achievement
Cannot set target for past quarters
Only HOD of that department can set targets

features.name: Auto-Dormancy Engine & Tiered Alerts
features.description: Implement automated status transitions: at_risk after 1 month, dormant after 3 months. Tiered notifications: 1mo=dashboard indicator, 2mo=HOD alert, 3mo=Director+HOD alert. Auto-reactivation on revenue.
test_steps: Department with 1 month no revenue shows 'at_risk' on dashboard
Department with 2 months no revenue triggers HOD notification
Department with 3 months no revenue auto-transitions to dormant
Dormant transition triggers notification to Director AND HOD
All status transitions recorded in history table
Logging revenue for dormant department auto-reactivates to active
Reactivation recorded in history with reason
Status check runs on dashboard load (or via scheduled function)
Notification appears in sh_notifications table
